title: Homepage headline
description: The words the homepage's headline cycles through, read as "<verb> your <noun>." The two lists step together, so the first verb and first noun are shown first and are what screen readers and search engines read.

verbs.description: What a promoter does to find a DJ, capitalized: "Find", "Dig up".

nouns.description: Who they're looking for, in lowercase unless it's a name or an acronym: "DJ", "b2b duo".
